limitations: Static editor extraction only; no entry/gameplay/Lua changes. _extraction metadata is not executable bindings; Buttons have IDs but no callbacks.
Cloud state cannot be inferred offline. Default skin/background,no purchases,no story progress are explicit snapshot assumptions.
Hidden background category is an editable alternative in the same JSON; category switching requires future Lua binding.
Pen.plaque quadratic corners approximated by Panel borderRadius11; strokes/colors/bounds preserved. Vector checks/lock arcs approximate with editable rotated/rounded Panels.
Portrait contain preserved; background postcards use previewImage9:20 cover,not square-cropped themes.
Name widths measured from source font via FreeType; exact NVG glyph positions and editor sans may differ.
Density-effective403.2x896 canvas;percent widths/bottom56 retained. Other sizes need recorded dynamic min/floor/text-measure formulas recomputed.
Outfit switch animation,category fade,dynamic pagination,purchase/settings overlays remain original Lua-owned behavior.
Tabs independently copied from bottom-tabs.ui.json without custom component registration; gear approximation documented there.
JSON/reference validation only; no build or runtime screenshot.
